description.value: Mediterranean Specialty Foods is a specialty grocery on Vancouver's Commercial Drive carrying a wide range of Mediterranean products including authentic olives from Italy, Greece, Turkey, Lebanon, and Spain, and cheeses from Northern Macedonia, Greece, Turkey, and the Balkans. The store is known for daily fresh-baked pies, hand-crafted baklava, and borek, alongside an extensive selection of dry goods, frozen items, and dairy. Commercial Drive is a well-established cycling corridor in Vancouver, making this a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking specialty provisions.
